summary: Ratio comparisons cross-multiplied fixed-size integers, causing overflow panics with overflow checks or incorrect comparisons when multiplication wraps. The added regression test compares 128u8/1 with 1/128 and several nearby i8 fractions. The fix replaces cross multiplication with direct comparisons for equal denominators or numerators and recursive quotient/remainder comparisons otherwise; PartialOrd and PartialEq delegate to Ord. The reversal restores the original comparison macro in src/rational.rs while preserving the regression test. No builds or tests were run.
